newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tem Fat Hing Fung plans unit spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Tem Fat Hing Fung plans unit spinoff.

text.p: Tem Fat Hing Fung (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it has submitted an application to the Hong Kong stock exchange for a separate listing of its proposed demerged metals operations.
"An advance booking form of application to the Stock Exchange for the listing of the shares...has been submitted," the group's chairman Raymond Chan said in a statement.
Tem Fat Hing Fung said it was considering a demerger of the group's metals operation into a newly formed subsidiary.

The subsidiary will engage in refining, casting, assaying, wholesaleing and trading of precious metals and related arbitrage and hedging operations. It will also invest in companies engaging in metals base business.

Upon completion of the demerger, Tem Fat Hing Fung's business will be trimmed to property investment and development, wholesale and retail of gold ornaments, diamonds and other jewellery products, and the provison of financial serivces and investments in marketable securities.

Chan said the proposed demerger would enable the subsidiary to develop an identity as an independently listed group engaged in metal business and to be recognised as an international gold bullion trading house. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
